title: ModuFlow Delivery Manifest Envelope
description: Standardized handoff envelope for all 11 ModuFlow stage deliverables (Single Source of Truth).

artifacts.description: Physical deliverable artifacts within the stage directory.

role.description: Role of artifact (e.g., report, fakedoor, prd, design, code, test_report, release_notes).

path.description: Relative file path strictly confined inside the stage directory.

risk_flags.description: Deterministic safety flags triggering Red Gate (🔴) escalations.

payment.description: True if touching real currency payments, IAP pricing ladders, Stripe/StoreKit.

privacy.description: True if modifying privacy policies, ATT tracking, cross-border data.

user_data.description: True if collecting sensitive user data (PII, location, contacts).

encryption.description: True if touching Keychain, keystore, or cryptographic secrets.

lead_permissions.description: True if attempting to modify lead agent permissions or authorization.yaml.

public_statement.description: True if making public store declarations or public announcements.

data_dictionary.description: True if modifying business data dictionary schema or breaking DDL.
